To create a new account:
1. Tap the **Sign Up** button on the welcome screen 2. Enter your email address 3. Choose a secure password 4. Verify your email through the link we send you 5. Complete your profile setup
Your account will be ready to use immediately after verification.
How do I create a new account?
Getting Started

If you've forgotten your password:
1. Tap **Forgot Password** on the login screen 2. Enter your email address 3. Check your email for a reset link 4. Click the link and enter your new password 5. Confirm your new password
For security reasons, password reset links expire after 24 hours.
How do I reset my password?

- Access previously synced content - Create and edit items locally - View your saved favorites - Changes sync automatically when you reconnect

Can I use the app offline?

Dark mode can be enabled in two ways:
**Automatic (Recommended):** - Go to **Settings** → **Appearance** - Select **System** to match your device settings
**Manual:** - Go to **Settings** → **Appearance** - Choose **Light** or **Dark**
The app will remember your preference across sessions.
How do I enable dark mode?
Settings

We take your privacy and security seriously:
✓ **End-to-end encryption** for sensitive data ✓ **Secure cloud backup** with AES-256 encryption ✓ **Two-factor authentication** available ✓ **Zero-knowledge architecture** - we can't access your encrypted data ✓ **Regular security audits** by independent firms
You can review our full security practices in Settings → Privacy & Security.
Is my data secure?
Privacy & Security

To export your data:
1. Go to **Settings** → **Data Management** 2. Tap **Export Data** 3. Choose your preferred format: - **JSON** - Full data export - **CSV** - Spreadsheet compatible - **PDF** - Human-readable format 4. Select what to include (documents, settings, etc.) 5. Tap **Export** and choose where to save
Exports are generated immediately and include all your content.
How do I export my data?

**macOS:** Requires macOS 26.0 or later - Apple Silicon and Intel Macs
All your data syncs seamlessly across all your devices via iCloud.

How do I contact support?

Yes! Sharing is easy:
**Individual Items:** 1. Tap the **Share** button on any item 2. Choose how to share (link, email, message) 3. Set permissions (view only or edit)
**Collections:** 1. Open a collection 2. Tap the three dots menu 3. Select **Share Collection** 4. Choose recipients and permissions
You can revoke access anytime from the sharing settings.
Can I share content with others?

We offer flexible plans:
**Free:** - Up to 100 items - Basic features - 1 GB storage
**Pro** ($4.99/month or $49.99/year): - Unlimited items - Advanced features - 100 GB storage - Priority support - Offline mode
**Family** ($9.99/month or $99.99/year): - Everything in Pro - Up to 6 family members - 500 GB shared storage - Family sharing features
All plans include a **14-day free trial**!
